verdict.rationale: The firm's own contact page lists offices beyond India (Singapore 'cam singapore Pte Ltd', Abu Dhabi 'cam middle east', plus GIFT City), showing a qualified multi-jurisdiction presence rather than pure India-only practice. However, there is no evidence of full-service qualified practices or licensed attorneys in major global hubs (e.g., US, UK, EU) or detail on the scope/size of the Singapore/Abu Dhabi offices. Missing for 10: scope/headcount of overseas offices, evidence of local bar qualifications abroad, coverage in more jurisdictions beyond GIFT City/Singapore/Abu Dhabi.
